deliverables: Performance optimization with 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization
Operational excellence including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI
Ecosystem support including features requested by production users and pipeline integrators, Hydra Alliance facilitation, hackathons, and developer relations
Maintenance and developer experience including CI, tooling, and technical debt reduction
request.recipient: Input Output Global / Intersect administrative treasury governance
request.what: Fund four Hydra v2 workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience/maintenance to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution on Cardano.
Hydra is already running or has powered workloads for Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 and states the funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
The proposal says Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero fees inside a head, high throughput, and L1-grade settlement guarantees.
The proposal asserts Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, about $0.17 per payment transaction, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making high-performance use cases uncompetitive on L1 alone.
The proposal claims the funded performance workstream will deliver 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduce L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.

The proposal asserts Hydra applications can increase Cardano ecosystem activity, TVL, L1 settlement usage, and protocol revenue through head lifecycle transactions and optional internal fee routing to the treasury.
The proposal states Hydra uses the same scripts, Plutus, and EUTXO model as Cardano, allowing what runs on Cardano to run in Hydra unchanged.
The proposal claims multiple provisional users are evaluating Hydra, including Bodega Market, Atlas Defi, Wingriders, Houselink, and European Public Network.

The proposal claims it advances treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue, and aligns with Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening across performance, operations, ecosystem support, and developer experience, but most material adoption, economic, and outcome claims are asserted in the proposal text rather than backed by budget analysis, feasibility analysis, alternatives, failure-mode analysis, or quantified community impact evidence.
